edges.description: A user conducts multiple periodic body scans to track muscular transformation over time.
Deep vision analysis of body scans produces granular muscle tier ratings from S to C.
Muscle rankings dictate training volume distribution, prioritizing lagging muscle groups.
Multimodal vision scans identify available raw ingredients and nutritional pantry inventory.
Detected ingredients are synthesized into executable meal recipes.
Target macronutrient constraints constrain recipe generation to satisfy daily nutritional quotas.
